status: Partial skill with physical projectile, explicit host precision-region calibration and shared Solar/Ophidia resources

policies.geometry: Server records uninflated target AABB and collision inflation before contact reactions. Relative world-axis x/y/z are not clamped; absent or degenerate geometry is explicit. This is not model-space animated weakpoint data.
policies.classification: Skill requires an externally linked target-owned precision classifier Profile. Synthetic target sources define inclusive normalized boxes and output exactly 0/1. No target automatically receives a guessed head region; unconfigured targets in this test classifier are body hits. Profile/unit validation does not itself calibrate real weakpoints.
policies.snapshot: Four Guardian/combatant body/precision damage snapshots capture intrinsic precision and on-use modifiers on cast. Current target type chooses the amount at contact. Geometry retains collision-time bounds; region policy is queried at contact. Ophidia on-hit contributions use the current source/Buff state.
policies.precision_factor: Outgoing has a named chorus:precision multiply stage. Intrinsic 0.5 delta is captured at cast and remains available after deselection, with existing shield factor exclusion support.
policies.hits: Only live observed targets with explicit not-allied relation receive damage. Unknown relation, unavailable/dead targets and absent geometry do not guess damage. Block/expiry/unloaded contacts spend the charge and end without refunds.
policies.radiant: An APPLIED precision damage receipt grants the existing shared Radiant for ten seconds, including lethal hits. Blocked/immune/cancelled/failed results do not grant it; this receipt qualification and posthumous/current source behavior require original-game calibration.
policies.resources: Uses shared Solar uses/progress pair with intrinsic extra 1, base 1/145.2 and CES .8; ordinary cycles yield one, Ophidia controls linked yield and recent-use exception. No separate full account is created on Solar knife reselection.
policies.collision: Synthetic physics calibration gravity 0, drag 1, lifetime 2s; stop at first block/entity contact, no tracking. The known 40m/s is not a proof of original flight, aim assist, friendly interception, clipping or animation.
policies.unloaded: Minecraft host ends flights at unavailable entity-simulation regions, even when terrain is loaded. Runtime ownership also cleans up flights that no longer receive native ticks; no chunk tickets or replayed motion. This is distinct from normal physical lifetime expiry and is not an original Destiny ballistic parameter.

gaps: Original flight gravity/drag/lifetime, targeting/aim assist and contact policy require calibration; placeholder projectile visual and no throw animation.
Host weakpoint/hit-region catalogue, entity rotation/animated bones, collision-envelope precision policy and complete shield/target/archetype damage scaling remain incomplete.
Original on-use versus on-hit stat sampling, current target type across mixed combat and precision-hit immunity/kill/posthumous policies are explicit choices, not independently measured.
Full Solar knife catalogue, formal subclass/Exotic restrictions, Gambler dodge displacement/near-enemy qualification, HUD and active-state persistence remain incomplete.
